loss: L_y=-(1/(2M))*sum_m log p_m(y) -(1/2)*log q_y; q=mean_m softmax(z_m)
observed_pool_Hessian: H_q,y=sum_m rho_m^y*H_m^y -[sum_m rho_m^y*h_m^y*h_m^y^T -s_q^y*s_q^y^T], H_m^y=-Hessian_W log p_m(y)
pool_true_Fisher: F_q=E_x sum_c q_c*s_q^c*s_q^c^T =E_x Jq^T diag(1/q) Jq
composite_GGN_model_Fisher: C_L=(1/(2M))*sum_m F_m +(1/2)*F_q PSD; natural outputs z_m and log(q)
proper_Fisher_interpretation: Fixed head-index augmented likelihood: choose pooled head with probability1/2 and each member head1/(2M), then sample class from selected head. Not Fisher of total observed composite-gradient outer product.
genuine_pool_cross_routes: F_q=E_x sum_c sum_mn q_c*rho_m^c*rho_n^c*h_m^c*h_n^c^T; unequal-route terms generally nonzero, whole sum PSD
one_use_fast_factor_layer: u_m=S_m W R_m a_m^0; alpha_m=R_m a_m^0; b_m^c=S_m^T grad_u log p_m(c); h_m^c=alpha_m tensor b_m^c
conditional_KFAC: F_m,W approximately A_m tensor G_m, A_m=E_x alpha_m alpha_m^T, G_m=E_x,c~p_m b_m^c b_m^c^T; assumes conditional activation/cotangent factorization
member_loss_approximation: C_member_hat=(1/(2M))*sum_m A_m tensor G_m; no pool Fisher included
pooled_factor_product: Abar tensor Gbar=(1/M^2)*sum_mn A_m tensor G_n; artificial factor pairings differ from genuine pool mixed-route terms
stratification_difference: mean_m A_m tensor G_m -Abar tensor Gbar=mean_m (A_m-Abar) tensor (G_m-Gbar); no PSD/error dominance
tying_pullback: vec(U_m)=D_m vec(W), D_m=R_m^T tensor S_m; D_m^T(A_m^0 tensor G_m^0)D_m=(R_m A_m^0 R_m^T) tensor (S_m^T G_m^0 S_m)
replica_equivalence: T^T diag(B_m) T=sum_m D_m^T B_m D_m; exact shared pullback of conventional untied member KFAC block approximation
multiple_use_warning: h_m^c=sum_t alpha_mt tensor b_mt^c; member Fisher includes t!=u terms; node/edge position approximation must be declared in addition to member stratification
pool_single_use_tensor_expansion: F_q=E_x,c~q sum_mn rho_m^c*rho_n^c*(alpha_m alpha_n^T) tensor (b_m^c b_n^c^T)
PSD_pair_factorization_requirement: Use consistent joint activation covariance and joint responsibility-weighted cotangent covariance banks; arbitrary independently normalized pair estimates need not preserve PSD.
shared_SPD_step: H=C_hat+lambda I SPD, lambda>0; H p=g_current; delta_W=-eta*p; g_current^T delta_W=-eta*g_current^T H^-1*g_current<0 if nonzero gradient
finite_step_bound: eta<2*g^T*p/(L_W*norm(p)^2), assuming Lipschitz shared-block gradient; eta<2*lambda/L_W is conservative exact-solve bound
approximate_solve_condition: r=g-Hp; g^Tp=p^THp+r^Tp; positive g^Tp or sufficient residual bound ensures directional descent. CG from zero has Galerkin identity in exact arithmetic.
history_qualification: Stale SPD curvature with current gradient still gives directional descent; stale gradient/momentum not guaranteed. Simultaneous ordinary private Adam does not inherit full-loss descent.
